title: Bilingual receptionist
description:
Company Description
Catalyze X is a leading outsourcing partner specializing in delivering cost-effective, highly efficient labor solutions for businesses across various industries. We help companies grow by delivering top-tier talent and support.
Role Description
We are seeking a highly professional and empathetic  Paralegal Receptionist to support a legal team remotely. The ideal candidate will be fluent in  Spanish and English , with  Portuguese as a strong preference , and will serve as the first point of contact for clients, ensuring a smooth intake and client communication experience.
Key Responsibilities
Answer and route high volumes of incoming calls in Spanish and English with professionalism and empathy
Take detailed messages and leave accurate notes for attorney/client callbacks
Manage front desk operations, including greeting walk-ins and handling inquiries
Provide support during high-traffic periods and maintain a calm, composed demeanor with frustrated or emotional clients (usually during the intake process).
Collaborate with legal assistants and attorneys to ensure timely follow-ups
Assist with administrative duties such as fax assignments and scheduling meetings
Coordinate with colleagues to ensure coverage at the front desk
Maintain confidentiality and professionalism in all interactions
Qualifications
Strong American accent with excellent English communication skills (spoken and written)
Bilingual (Spanish and English) is required; Portuguese proficiency is preferred Candidates with trilingual proficiency (Spanish, English, and Portuguese) are highly encouraged to apply Must be based in Brazil, Colombia, or anywhere in Latin America
Knowledge of legal procedures, case management, and document handling is a plus
Exceptional organizational and multitasking abilities
Proficiency with legal case management software is a plus
Ability to thrive both independently and as part of a collaborative team in a fast-paced environment
Background in workers' compensation required
Background in personal injury law is a plus
Compensation: $6 to $7 per hour (Negotiable DOE)
Working Hours: Eastern or Pacific Time Zone
If you're ready to make a meaningful impact and become a key member of our team, we'd love to hear from you .

title: Customer service representative
description:
Customer Service Representative
Location: Fully Remote (LATAM)
Job Type: Full-TimeLove helping people and solving problems fast?We’re looking for someone who can deliver high-quality customer experiences at scale, while keeping every interaction clear, human, and efficient. This is a hands-on role where responsiveness, empathy, and execution matter every day.About Uproot Clean
Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, performance-driven consumer brand built for pet owners. We create high-performance, eco-friendly cleaning solutions designed to make life easier without compromising sustainability.
Customer experience is at the core of our brand. Every interaction matters, and how we show up for our customers directly impacts retention, trust, and growth.The Role
This is a high-volume, execution-focused role. You will manage day-to-day customer interactions across multiple channels, ensuring fast, accurate, and human responses.
You arenotjust answering tickets—you are shaping how customers experience the brand.This Role Is For You If:
You communicate clearly, empathetically, and efficiently
You are comfortable handling high volumes of customer interactions
You stay calm under pressure and solve problems quickly
You pay attention to details and don’t let things slip
You take ownership of issues until they are fully resolved
You are comfortable working independently in a remote environmentThis Role Is NOT For You If:
You avoid dealing with difficult customers
You prioritize speed over accuracy and quality
You are not comfortable multitasking across platformsWhat You'll Do
Customer Support Execution
Manage and respond to customer inquiries via email and support platforms
Ensure fast, accurate, and high-quality responses at scale
Maintain a consistent and professional brand voice
Social Media Support
Respond to DMs and comments across platforms like Instagram, Facebook, and Tik Tok
Engage with the community while maintaining brand tone and consistency
Order & Refund Management
Process order changes, cancellations, refunds, and exchanges
Ensure all actions follow company policies and are accurately executed
Conflict Resolution
Handle complaints with empathy and clarity
Investigate issues thoroughly and provide complete resolutions
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Share customer feedback and recurring issues with internal teams
Help identify patterns that can improve product or operationsRequirements
Must have:
Experience in customer service(ecommerce or DTC preferred)
Strongwritten communication skills in English
Experiencehandling social media interactions is a strong plus
Highattention to detail and ability to multitask
Comfortableworking in fast-paced environments
Work Requirements
⏰Schedule:Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST
Workspace:Fixed, professional setup required (stable internet + backup plan)Benefits & Compensation
Fully remote- work from anywhere in LATAM.
Paid time off
Flex days.Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire
Ownership & autonomy- trusted to build and execute strategy
Professional development- opportunities to learn and grow with the business
Ready to Apply?
If you care about delivering great customer experiences and want to be part of a fast-moving team, apply now.

title: Senior backend engineer (node.js) | integração
description:
Descrição da Empresa: A Carefy é uma plataforma especializada em auditoria para operadoras de planos de saúde, utilizando inteligência artificial para combater fraudes e desperdícios no ciclo de atendimento. Combinamos tecnologia avançada e expertise em fluxos de auditoria para gerar economias significativas para nossos clientes. Nosso impacto abrange mais de 8 milhões de pessoas, trabalhando com operadoras líderes como Hapvida e Porto Seguro. Somos movidos pelo compromisso de transformar decisões complexas e melhorar a sustentabilidade do setor de saúde.
Descrição do Cargo: Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Desenvolvedora Backend Sênior com forte visão arquitetural e experiência em sistemas de alta escalabilidade para atuar no time de integração da Carefy. Esse cargo envolve o desenho e desenvolvimento de soluções para garantir a interoperabilidade da plataforma com os sistemas das operadoras de saúde, assegurando fluxo de dados com segurança e alta performance.
Você deverá propor soluções, analisar requisitos técnicos e colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entregar projetos de alto impacto. Atuará como referência técnica, participando diretamente da definição de arquiteturas junto aos times de TI dos clientes e traduzindo desafios complexos em soluções estruturadas para o time interno. Também será responsável por elevar o nível técnico da equipe por meio da definição de padrões de engenharia, disseminação de boas práticas e organização das demandas.
Qualificações
Acima de 6 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software
Acima de 4 anos com Node.js e Type Script em produção
Acima de 4 anos com bancos relacionais (My SQL), incluindo modelagem e otimização
Experiência com arquitetura de software (Clean Architecture, Hexagonal, DDD)
Experiência com cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure) e mensageria (Rabbit MQ/Kafka)
Experiência com APIs RESTful escaláveis
Experiência em ambientes de alta criticidade e alto volume de dados
Domínio de frameworks como Nest JS e/ou Next.js
Conhecimento em testes automatizados (TDD, unitários e integração)
Habilidade para trabalho colaborativo
Visão sistêmica e entendimento do impacto técnico no produto
Comunicação assertiva com clientes e time interno
Autonomia para conduzir projetos complexos e gerenciar riscos
Forte capacidade de resolução de problemas com foco na causa raiz
Será um diferencial: Experiência com PHP: Temos legado e integrações onde esse conhecimento será muito útil para modernização; Experiência na sustentação de aplicações escaláveis utilizando Kubernetes e Terraform;
Vivência com pipelines de CI/CD (Bitbucket Pipelines, Git Hub Actions, Jenkins, etc.);
Conhecimentos em Segurança da Informação (OWASP, OAuth2).
Atribuições:
Interface Técnica com Clientes: Atuar como ponto focal em reuniões com os times de TI dos clientes (operadoras de saúde) para alinhar requisitos de integração, layouts de dados e especificações de API;
Gestão e Organização Técnica: Traduzir requisitos de negócio em tarefas técnicas claras, quebrando demandas complexas em entregáveis menores para orientar o trabalho dos desenvolvedores Juniors e Plenos;
Arquitetura e Design: Projetar e desenvolver soluções escaláveis, resilientes e de alta performance utilizando Node.js (Nest JS/Next.js);
Sustentação e Confiabilidade: Atuar na manutenção dos sistemas em produção, identificando, diagnosticando e corrigindo bugs e falhas (em sistemas, fontes de dados e APIs) de forma ágil para garantir a continuidade dos serviços;
Mentoria e Qualidade: Realizar Code Reviews rigorosos e disseminar boas práticas (Clean Code, SOLID), elevando a barra técnica da equipe;
Padronização e Performance: Definir padrões de desenvolvimento e identificar gargalos de performance em cenários de alto volume de dados.
O que oferecemos?
Modalidade Flexível: Híbrido ou 100% Remoto
Possibilidade de regime CLT ou PJ;
Se CLT, convênio com Bradesco Saúde e Cartão Flash (VR);
Ambiente colaborativo e desafiador;
Horários flexíveis;
Autonomia para propor e implementar novas tecnologias!

description:
Company Description
The Institute of Project Management (IPM) is a globally recognised organisation specialising in project management education, certification, membership, and research. Project management experience is essential.
Experience using CRM systems (Salesforce, Hub Spot, or similar).
Preferred: Experience in corporate training, professional education, Saa S, or consulting .

title: Senior business analyst - supply chain
description:
Who We Are
We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation.
Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.
Who We Are Looking For
We are currently seeking a Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain , a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution).
This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.
If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.
Key Responsibilities
Business Requirements & Client Engagement
• Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.
• Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.
• Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.
• Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.
• Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.
Solution Design, Implementation & Testing
• Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).
• Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.
• Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.
• Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.
• Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.
• Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.
• Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.
• Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.
Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)
• Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.
• Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.
• Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.
Must Have
• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.
• Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).
• Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.
• Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).
• Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.
• Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
• Experience with project management and collaboration tools.
• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.
• Availability to travel.
• Legally authorized to work in Brazil.
What We Offer
• Competitive salary and benefits package.
• Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.
• A collaborative and international work environment.
• Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.
Why Hoist?
If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.
Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

title: Risk & governance analyst - remote work
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.
Overview of the role
The Risk & Governance Analyst position involves establishing and overseeing the IT governance framework to mitigate operational risks and ensure regulatory compliance, providing strategic metrics that facilitate informed decision-making by senior management. As the strategic architect behind technology's safety and compliance, your mission is to bridge the gap between complex technical operations and business objectives by identifying potential threats before they materialize. You'll build a culture of risk awareness, ensuring IT infrastructure remains resilient, compliant, and aligned with international standards like ISO 27001 and COBIT.
Key responsibilities
- Coordinating information security risk assessment and reassessment activities.
- Following up with risk owners and business areas to obtain status updates and evidence.
- Consolidating, measuring, and communicating monthly KPIs for IT teams.
- Ensuring that periodic reviews include open, in-progress, and closed risks.
- Supporting risk reporting and governance communication to management.
Requirements
- Risk Analysis: 2+ years of professional experience in risk analysis.
- ISO Knowledge: Foundation knowledge of ISO 31000.
- Analytical Background: Background in risk and data analysis.
- Office Suite: Proficiency in Google Office or Microsoft Office.
- Operating Systems: Experience with Windows 10 or superior.
- Language Proficiency: Advanced level of English.

Benefits:
- Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

- Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.
- Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.
- Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.
- Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.
- Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.
- Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.
If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Commercial lead — brazil
description:
About Regrow
Regrow is a climate-tech company on a mission to make resilient agriculture the global norm. We partner with food, beverage, textile, and financial sector leaders to measure, reduce, and report on the environmental impact of their agricultural supply chains. Our platform combines agronomic science, remote sensing, and data analytics to help organizations meet their sustainability goals while supporting farmers through the transition to regenerative practices.

About the Role
As Commercial Lead in Brazil, you will drive Regrow’s commercial growth in one of our most strategic markets. This is a full-cycle, new-business role: you will open new accounts, build and qualify pipeline, and close enterprise deals with customers across Brazil’s agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.
You will work closely with our Head of Lat Am, global go-to-market team, and customer success organization to bring Regrow’s platform to food and beverage brands, textile companies, biofuel producers, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, traders, banks, and financial institutions operating across grains, beef, and dairy value chains.
This is a plug-and-play role for a senior commercial professional who brings an established network and deep sector understanding. You will act as a market-opening engine, converting your credibility and relationships into new logos and meaningful ARR growth.

What You’ll Do
Own the full commercial cycle for new business in Brazil: prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close.
Open doors with senior decision-makers and executive sponsors at strategic target accounts.
Build and maintain a qualified pipeline sourced exclusively from new accounts, with disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting.
Expand Regrow’s presence in priority verticals, including CPG, textiles, biofuels, agribusiness, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, and financial institutions.
Position Regrow credibly within Brazil’s grains, beef, and dairy value chains, adapting our narrative to local market context.
Partner with global GTM, product, science, and customer success teams to shape complex deals and ensure smooth post-close transitions.
Provide structured market intelligence on competitive dynamics, buyer needs, adoption barriers, and regulatory signals.
Represent Regrow at industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.
What You’ll Bring
Proven experience in hunting and opening new enterprise accounts in complex B2 B environments.
Track record of closing new business and an active network that can be activated in the short term.
Strong presence in agribusiness with real access to decision-makers across agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.
Deep understanding of Brazilian agri-food ecosystems and buyers such as CPGs, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, banks, and financial institutions.
Experience in or strong affinity with climate tech, sustainability, regenerative agriculture, carbon footprint, MRV, traceability, or Saa S platforms.
Executive presence and the credibility to engage senior buyers as a commercial partner, not a transactional seller.
Ability to translate technical and scientific topics into clear, concrete commercial proposals.
Comfort operating in a matrixed environment with global teams and in dynamic, high-growth contexts.
Native or near-native Portuguese fluency.
Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to present to and collaborate with global stakeholders regularly.
Willingness to travel as needed for industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.
Nice to Have
Recent experience in scale-ups, startups, or high-growth technology companies.
Experience selling innovative categories into traditional industries.
Working knowledge of Spanish.
Why Regrow
Meaningful mission: shape the future of agriculture and help build climate resilience at scale.
High-growth, scale-up environment with autonomy and real ownership.
A collaborative global team combining commercial, scientific, and technical expertise.
Competitive compensation and benefits.
 
Acerca de Regrow
Regrow es una empresa de climate tech con la misión de convertir la agricultura resiliente en la norma global. Trabajamos con líderes de los sectores alimentario, de bebidas, textil y financiero para medir, reducir y reportar el impacto ambiental de sus cadenas de suministro agrícolas. Nuestra plataforma combina ciencia agronómica, sensores remotos y analítica de datos para ayudar a las organizaciones a alcanzar sus objetivos de sostenibilidad, apoyando al mismo tiempo a los productores en la transición hacia prácticas regenerativas.
Sobre el Rol
Como Commercial Lead — Brasil, impulsarás el crecimiento comercial de Regrow en uno de nuestros mercados más estratégicos. Este es un rol de ciclo completo enfocado en nuevos negocios: abrirás nuevas cuentas, construirás y calificarás pipeline, y cerrarás acuerdos enterprise con clientes a lo largo de las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial de Brasil.
Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con nuestra Directora de Lat Am, el equipo global de go-to-market y la organización de customer success para llevar la plataforma de Regrow a marcas de alimentos y bebidas, empresas textiles, productores de biocombustibles, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, traders, bancos e instituciones financieras que operan en las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos.
Este es un rol plug-and-play para un profesional comercial senior que aporte una red establecida y un profundo conocimiento sectorial. Actuarás como motor de apertura de mercado, convirtiendo tu credibilidad y relaciones en nuevos logos y crecimiento significativo de ARR.
Qué Harás
Serás dueño del ciclo comercial completo de nuevos negocios en Brasil: prospección, descubrimiento, calificación, propuesta, negociación y cierre.
Abrirás puertas con tomadores de decisiones senior y sponsors ejecutivos en cuentas objetivo estratégicas.
Construirás y mantendrás un pipeline calificado proveniente exclusivamente de nuevas cuentas, con disciplina en CRM y precisión en el forecast.
Expandirás la presencia de Regrow en verticales prioritarias: CPG, textiles, biocombustibles, agronegocios, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos e instituciones financieras.
Posicionarás a Regrow con credibilidad dentro de las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos de Brasil, adaptando nuestra narrativa al contexto local.
Colaborarás con los equipos globales de GTM, producto, ciencia y customer success para estructurar acuerdos complejos y asegurar transiciones post-cierre fluidas.
Proporcionarás inteligencia estructurada de mercado sobre dinámicas competitivas, necesidades de compradores, barreras de adopción y señales regulatorias.
Representarás a Regrow en conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.
Qué Aportarás
Experiencia comprobada en hunting y apertura de nuevas cuentas enterprise en entornos B2 B complejos.
Historial de cierre de nuevos negocios y una red activa que pueda ser activada en el corto plazo.
Fuerte presencia en agronegocios con acceso real a tomadores de decisiones en las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial.
Comprensión profunda de los ecosistemas agroalimentarios brasileños y de compradores como CPGs, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, bancos e instituciones financieras.
Experiencia en o fuerte afinidad con climate tech, sostenibilidad, agricultura regenerativa, huella de carbono, MRV, trazabilidad o plataformas Saa S.
Presencia ejecutiva y credibilidad para relacionarse con compradores senior como socio comercial, no como vendedor transaccional.
Capacidad para traducir temas técnicos y científicos en propuestas comerciales claras y concretas.
Comodidad operando en un entorno matricial con equipos globales y en contextos dinámicos de alto crecimiento.
Dominio nativo o casi nativo del portugués.
Dominio profesional del inglés, con capacidad para presentar y colaborar con stakeholders globales de manera regular.
Disponibilidad para viajar según sea necesario para conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.
Deseable
Experiencia reciente en scale-ups, startups o empresas de tecnología de alto crecimiento.
Experiencia vendiendo categorías innovadoras a industrias tradicionales.
Conocimiento funcional del español.
Por Qué Regrow
Misión con propósito: dar forma al futuro de la agricultura y contribuir a construir resiliencia climática a escala.
Entorno de alto crecimiento tipo scale-up con autonomía y responsabilidad real.
Un equipo global colaborativo que combina experiencia comercial, científica y técnica.
Compensación y beneficios competitivos.

title: Product designer lead (ux/ui)
description: Professional English is a requirement for this role A challenge will be required for evaluation About Foundey Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage Saa S startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products. The Opportunity We are looking for a experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments. The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2 B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and Saa S sectors. Responsibilities Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design; Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions; Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and Saa S products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance; Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs; Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite; Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2 B software, and industry best practices in product design; Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team. Requirements Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams; Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools; Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, Fig Jam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle; Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2 B software; Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers; Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles. Preferred Qualifications6+ years of experience as a Product Designer Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.); Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions; Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers; Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams; Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions. Why Join Us?At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing Saa S and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You'll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: Peoplesoft dba
description:
People Soft Database Administrator (DBA)
Job Summary: EY is seeking a highly skilled Senior People Soft DBA with 8+ years of experience to lead the administration, maintenance, and optimization of People Soft environments (HCM, FSCM, or Campus Solutions). The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Oracle/SQL Server database management, People Tools architecture, and proven experience managing complex 24/7 production environments.
Core Responsibilities:
Environment Management: Lead installation, configuration, and maintenance of People Soft application servers, web servers (Web Logic), and process schedulers.
Upgrades & Patching: Manage full-cycle People Soft Image (PUM) updates and People Tools upgrades; execute Oracle database patching and version upgrades.
Performance Tuning: Perform advanced performance tuning at both Oracle database level (SQL tuning, indexing) and People Soft application level (App Server/Batch tuning).
Data Integrity & Security: Implement robust backup and recovery processes using Oracle RMAN; manage People Soft security (roles, permission lists, SSO).
Automation: Develop automation scripts (Shell, Python, Power Shell) for environment refreshes, backups, and monitoring.
Disaster Recovery: Design and test Disaster Recovery (DR) plans using Oracle Data Guard or similar tools.
Mentorship: Provide leadership and guidance to junior DBAs; collaborate with People Soft Developers and Functional Analysts.
Technical Skills Required
People Tools: Extensive experience with People Tools 8.5x – 8.6x (Application Designer, Data Mover, Change Assistant) Database: Mastery of Oracle 19c/21c, SQL, PL/SQL, RMAN. Experience with Exadata or OCI is a plus Middleware: Deep knowledge of Oracle Web Logic, Tuxedo, Integration Broker (IB) Operating Systems: Expert-level proficiency in Linux/Unix (OEL, Red Hat) and shell scripting Tools: Hands-on experience with People Tools or Stat for version control and migrations

title: Account manager
description:
Company Description
The Institute of Project Management (IPM) is a globally recognised organisation specialising in project management education, certification, membership, and research. With more than 35 years of experience, IPM has supported over 50,000 professionals and certified more than 6,000 Project Managers, partnering with 1,000+ organisations worldwide. title: Commercial lead — brazil
description:
About Regrow
Regrow is a climate-tech company on a mission to make resilient agriculture the global norm. We partner with food, beverage, textile, and financial sector leaders to measure, reduce, and report on the environmental impact of their agricultural supply chains. Our platform combines agronomic science, remote sensing, and data analytics to help organizations meet their sustainability goals while supporting farmers through the transition to regenerative practices.

About the Role
As Commercial Lead in Brazil, you will drive Regrow’s commercial growth in one of our most strategic markets. This is a full-cycle, new-business role: you will open new accounts, build and qualify pipeline, and close enterprise deals with customers across Brazil’s agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.
You will work closely with our Head of Lat Am, global go-to-market team, and customer success organization to bring Regrow’s platform to food and beverage brands, textile companies, biofuel producers, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, traders, banks, and financial institutions operating across grains, beef, and dairy value chains.
This is a plug-and-play role for a senior commercial professional who brings an established network and deep sector understanding. You will act as a market-opening engine, converting your credibility and relationships into new logos and meaningful ARR growth.

What You’ll Do
Own the full commercial cycle for new business in Brazil: prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close.
Open doors with senior decision-makers and executive sponsors at strategic target accounts.
Build and maintain a qualified pipeline sourced exclusively from new accounts, with disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting.
Expand Regrow’s presence in priority verticals, including CPG, textiles, biofuels, agribusiness, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, and financial institutions.
Position Regrow credibly within Brazil’s grains, beef, and dairy value chains, adapting our narrative to local market context.
Partner with global GTM, product, science, and customer success teams to shape complex deals and ensure smooth post-close transitions.
Provide structured market intelligence on competitive dynamics, buyer needs, adoption barriers, and regulatory signals.
Represent Regrow at industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.
What You’ll Bring
Proven experience in hunting and opening new enterprise accounts in complex B2 B environments.
Track record of closing new business and an active network that can be activated in the short term.
Strong presence in agribusiness with real access to decision-makers across agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.
Deep understanding of Brazilian agri-food ecosystems and buyers such as CPGs, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, banks, and financial institutions.
Experience in or strong affinity with climate tech, sustainability, regenerative agriculture, carbon footprint, MRV, traceability, or Saa S platforms.
Executive presence and the credibility to engage senior buyers as a commercial partner, not a transactional seller.
Ability to translate technical and scientific topics into clear, concrete commercial proposals.
Comfort operating in a matrixed environment with global teams and in dynamic, high-growth contexts.
Native or near-native Portuguese fluency.
Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to present to and collaborate with global stakeholders regularly.
Willingness to travel as needed for industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.
Nice to Have
Recent experience in scale-ups, startups, or high-growth technology companies.
Experience selling innovative categories into traditional industries.
Working knowledge of Spanish.
Why Regrow
Meaningful mission: shape the future of agriculture and help build climate resilience at scale.
High-growth, scale-up environment with autonomy and real ownership.
A collaborative global team combining commercial, scientific, and technical expertise.
Competitive compensation and benefits.
 
Acerca de Regrow
Regrow es una empresa de climate tech con la misión de convertir la agricultura resiliente en la norma global. Trabajamos con líderes de los sectores alimentario, de bebidas, textil y financiero para medir, reducir y reportar el impacto ambiental de sus cadenas de suministro agrícolas. Nuestra plataforma combina ciencia agronómica, sensores remotos y analítica de datos para ayudar a las organizaciones a alcanzar sus objetivos de sostenibilidad, apoyando al mismo tiempo a los productores en la transición hacia prácticas regenerativas.
Sobre el Rol
Como Commercial Lead — Brasil, impulsarás el crecimiento comercial de Regrow en uno de nuestros mercados más estratégicos. Este es un rol de ciclo completo enfocado en nuevos negocios: abrirás nuevas cuentas, construirás y calificarás pipeline, y cerrarás acuerdos enterprise con clientes a lo largo de las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial de Brasil.
Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con nuestra Directora de Lat Am, el equipo global de go-to-market y la organización de customer success para llevar la plataforma de Regrow a marcas de alimentos y bebidas, empresas textiles, productores de biocombustibles, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, traders, bancos e instituciones financieras que operan en las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos.
Este es un rol plug-and-play para un profesional comercial senior que aporte una red establecida y un profundo conocimiento sectorial. Actuarás como motor de apertura de mercado, convirtiendo tu credibilidad y relaciones en nuevos logos y crecimiento significativo de ARR.
Qué Harás
Serás dueño del ciclo comercial completo de nuevos negocios en Brasil: prospección, descubrimiento, calificación, propuesta, negociación y cierre.
Abrirás puertas con tomadores de decisiones senior y sponsors ejecutivos en cuentas objetivo estratégicas.
Construirás y mantendrás un pipeline calificado proveniente exclusivamente de nuevas cuentas, con disciplina en CRM y precisión en el forecast.
Expandirás la presencia de Regrow en verticales prioritarias: CPG, textiles, biocombustibles, agronegocios, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos e instituciones financieras.
Posicionarás a Regrow con credibilidad dentro de las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos de Brasil, adaptando nuestra narrativa al contexto local.
Colaborarás con los equipos globales de GTM, producto, ciencia y customer success para estructurar acuerdos complejos y asegurar transiciones post-cierre fluidas.
Proporcionarás inteligencia estructurada de mercado sobre dinámicas competitivas, necesidades de compradores, barreras de adopción y señales regulatorias.
Representarás a Regrow en conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.
Qué Aportarás
Experiencia comprobada en hunting y apertura de nuevas cuentas enterprise en entornos B2 B complejos.
Historial de cierre de nuevos negocios y una red activa que pueda ser activada en el corto plazo.
Fuerte presencia en agronegocios con acceso real a tomadores de decisiones en las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial.
Comprensión profunda de los ecosistemas agroalimentarios brasileños y de compradores como CPGs, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, bancos e instituciones financieras.
Experiencia en o fuerte afinidad con climate tech, sostenibilidad, agricultura regenerativa, huella de carbono, MRV, trazabilidad o plataformas Saa S.
Presencia ejecutiva y credibilidad para relacionarse con compradores senior como socio comercial, no como vendedor transaccional.
Capacidad para traducir temas técnicos y científicos en propuestas comerciales claras y concretas.
Comodidad operando en un entorno matricial con equipos globales y en contextos dinámicos de alto crecimiento.
Dominio nativo o casi nativo del portugués.
Dominio profesional del inglés, con capacidad para presentar y colaborar con stakeholders globales de manera regular.
Disponibilidad para viajar según sea necesario para conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.
Deseable
Experiencia reciente en scale-ups, startups o empresas de tecnología de alto crecimiento.
Experiencia vendiendo categorías innovadoras a industrias tradicionales.
Conocimiento funcional del español.
Por Qué Regrow
Misión con propósito: dar forma al futuro de la agricultura y contribuir a construir resiliencia climática a escala.
Entorno de alto crecimiento tipo scale-up con autonomía y responsabilidad real.
Un equipo global colaborativo que combina experiencia comercial, científica y técnica.
Compensación y beneficios competitivos.

title: Digital marketing ad strategist
description:
The Digital Marketing Ad Strategist is a responsible for the performance, health, and scalability of paid advertising accounts across Google Ads, Meta (Facebook & Instagram), and Linked In Ads. This role is heavily focused on account audits, ongoing optimization, technical troubleshooting, and performance improvements.
You will analyze existing ad accounts, identify inefficiencies and technical issues, recommend and implement fixes, and ensure tracking, structure, and strategy are aligned with business objectives.
Requirements
In-depth knowledge of the following platforms: Google ads, Facebook Ads, Microsoft Ads
Detail oriented
Key Responsibilities
Account Audits & Diagnostics
 • Conduct in-depth audits of Google Ads, Meta, Microsoft, and Linked In Ads accounts. Experience or working knowledge across secondary platforms, including Tik Tok, Pinterest, Reddit, X, Snapchat, Spotify, and Amazon.
 • Identify structural issues, wasted spend, tracking gaps, and performance blockers
 • Diagnose bugs and technical issues such as:
 • Incorrect or missing conversion tracking
 • Pixel or tag misfires
 • Attribution and reporting discrepancies
 • Budget pacing and delivery issues
 • Audience overlap and campaign cannibalization
 • Document findings and deliver clear, prioritized optimization recommendations
 Optimization & Performance Management
  • Continuous proactive optimization of campaigns, ad groups, keywords, audiences, bids, and creatives
 • Improve key performance metrics such as CPA, ROAS, CTR, and conversion rate
 • Manage and reallocate budgets based on performance and growth opportunities
 • Plan and execute A/B tests across targeting, creative, offers, and landing pages
 • Optimize accounts across full-funnel stages (awareness, consideration, conversion)
 Strategy & Execution
 • Translate business goals into effective paid media strategies
 • Ensure account structures align with funnel intent and buyer journeys
 • Align ad messaging with audience intent and platform best practices
 Tracking, Data & Reporting
 • Ensure accurate setup and ongoing validation of conversion tracking
 • Work with GA4, Google Tag Manager, and platform analytics to confirm data integrity
 • Analyze performance data to uncover insights, issues, and opportunities
 • Create performance reports that clearly explain results, risks, and next steps
 Process & Quality Control
  • Maintain clean account structure, naming conventions, and documentation
 • Build and follow optimization and audit checklists
 • Stay current on platform updates, policy changes, and best practices
 • Proactively flag risks, inefficiencies, or declining performance trends
Additional Tasks
 • Forecasts and initial ad spend recommendations to assist with the Sales team.
 • Have basic design knowledge and be able to coordinate ad copy and creative with internal team members.
Language Requirements
 • Fluent in English and Portuguese
Salary
$3000 BRL (Brazilian Real) / Per Month to start
Benefits after 6 months
Hiring Process:
Initial Interview with small knowledge test
Second interview with Ads team
Possible follow up questions / test
Final meet and greet meeting

title: Sr. compliance onboarding specialist
description:
About the Role
We are looking for a highly motivated and detail-oriented Senior Compliance Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team at Velafi. In this role, you will be instrumental in managing and enhancing the onboarding and KYC (Know Your Customer) processes for our clients across multiple jurisdictions, with a strong focus on Brazil and Latin America.
You will collaborate closely with Sales, Operations, and Compliance teams to design efficient, scalable onboarding frameworks that deliver a seamless customer experience while maintaining strict adherence to regulatory requirements. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced fintech environment and is passionate about balancing compliance excellence with business enablement.
Key Responsibilities

Contribute to the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of onboarding controls, policies, and procedures to ensure efficiency, scalability, and regulatory compliance.
Act as the subject matter expert for onboarding clients operating in Brazil, ensuring alignment with Brazilian local AML/CTF regulations and industry best practices.
Perform detailed reviews and analysis of B2 B customer documentation, including Customer Risk Assessments and Customer Due Diligence to support informed onboarding decisions.
Partner with Sales, Operations, and other internal stakeholders to provide clear guidance on compliance requirements, enabling smooth client onboarding and expansion into new markets. Advise internal teams on AML risks and regulatory considerations when entering new industries or geographic regions.
Conduct background checks, adverse media screenings, and ongoing monitoring of clients and prospects to identify and mitigate potential risks.
Support the Compliance function in applying regulatory frameworks across LATAM jurisdictions, ensuring compliant operations in Brazil matters.
What We’re Looking For

Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field, with a strong foundation in Compliance.
3+ years of hands-on experience in Compliance, preferably within fintech, digital banking, payments, or financial services environments.
Strong knowledge of KYC, AML, CDD, and CRA frameworks
Solid understanding of Brazilian AML/CTF regulations
Familiarity with international regulatory standards, including BSA, USA PATRIOT Act, and OFAC
Ability to evaluate complex customer structures, identify risks, and make sound compliance decisions.
Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to work cross-functionally and communicate complex regulatory concepts clearly.
Fluent in Spanish (English is a strong plus).
Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating in a dynamic, fast-growing environment with evolving regulatory landscapes.

description:

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.
We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.

Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
Trading Comparables (Comps)
Precedent Transactions

Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies

Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
Financial Modeling
Sourcing & Due Diligence
Industry and Company Research
And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.
This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.
Who We're Looking For:
This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.
How to Apply:
Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.
This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Investment banking intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program
Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.
We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.
Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.
What You'll Gain: Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including: 3-Statement Financial Modeling
Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
Trading Comparables (Comps)
Precedent Transactions
Advanced Excel & Power Point techniques
Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with: Pitch Book Development
Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
Financial Modeling
Sourcing & Due Diligence
Industry and Company Research
And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.
This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.
Who We're Looking For:
This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.
How to Apply:
Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.
This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

Nesta posição, você será responsável por coordenar iniciativas estratégicas de TI e infraestrutura digital entre a área de TI Global da BYD (China) e as operações no Brasil. Garante a execução dos projetos, o alinhamento entre stakeholders, a conformidade com a governança e a comunicação entre equipes multilíngues. Liderará o planejamento, execução e entrega de programas de infraestrutura de TI, redes, datacenter e transformação digital alinhados aos padrões globais da BYD e aos objetivos operacionais regionais.

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Liderar atividades de gestão de projetos de TI de ponta a ponta, incluindo planejamento, cronograma, controle de riscos e governança de entrega alinhados aos padrões de BYD Global IT.
  • Atuar como principal elo bilíngue entre a sede da BYD na China e as equipes operacionais no Brasil, garantindo comunicação precisa em mandarim, português e, quando necessário, inglês.
  • Coordenar projetos de infraestrutura, redes, datacenter, cyber segurança e plataformas digitais entre equipes multifuncionais.

  • Coordenar processos de gestão de mudanças para implantações de infraestrutura e transições operacionais.
  • Identificar riscos de projetos, dependências e estratégias de mitigação para garantir cumprimento de cronograma e qualidade.
  • Apoiar a integração entre iniciativas de infraestrutura de TI e operações industriais em ambientes de manufatura.
  • Colaborar com equipes de cyber segurança, redes, datacenter e suporte, garantindo alinhamento com prontidão operacional e continuidade de serviços.
  • Organizar e liderar reuniões de projetos interculturais, traduzindo discussões técnicas e estratégicas entre equipes de mandarim e português.
  • Manter repositórios de documentação de projetos, incluindo termos de abertura, registros de riscos, relatórios de governança e resumos executivos.
  • Promover melhoria contínua na governança de projetos, padrões de documentação e colaboração entre regiões.
  • Fornecer mentoria e orientação para coordenadores de projetos e analistas juniores dentro da estrutura do PMO.
Requisitos e qualificações
  • Graduação em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia de Sistemas ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Conhecimento sólido em plataformas de virtualização (VMware, Hyper‑V) e gerenciamento de armazenamento;
  • Experiência em operações de backup, validação de recuperação de dados e monitoramento com Zabbix, PRTG ou Grafana;
  • Conhecimento de conceitos de DRP/BCP, métricas RTO/RPO e testes de recuperação de desastres;
  • Conhecimento de ambientes de servidores Windows e Linux, redes e gestão de capacidade;
  • Familiaridade com frameworks ISO 27001 e ITIL, garantindo alinhamento de documentação e conformidade;
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de troubleshooting para incidentes de hardware e software;
  • Inglês avançado para documentação técnica e comunicação com fornecedores e stakeholders;
  • Capacidade de coordenar manutenção de fornecedores e validar entregáveis;
  • Alto nível de disciplina operacional, controle de configuração e rotinas de manutenção preventiva;
  • Conhecimento das normas de segurança NR aplicáveis a operações de datacenter e conformidade com EHS;
  • Disponibilidade para participar de testes de DRP/BCP e operações em turnos;
  • Certificação em VMware Certified Professional – VCP (Data Center Virtualization); Microsoft Server Administrator e/ou ITIL Foundation (Service Operations ou Service Transition);

Desejável:

  • Certificação em Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Administrator (MCSA) ou Azure Administrator (AZ-104);
  • CompTIA Network+ ou Cloud+ (compreensão de redes de datacenter);
  • Veeam Certified Engineer (VMCE) ou Veritas NetBackup Administrator;
  • ISO/IEC 27001 Internal Auditor (desejável);
  • Certificação profissional de monitoramento Zabbix / PRTG;
  • Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) – opcional.

Aqui na BYD priorizamos o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores e estamos em busca constante de melhorias para o nosso pacote de benefícios. Seu pacote vai contar com:

description:
Company Description

Miratech helps visionaries change the world. We are a global IT services and consulting company that brings together enterprise and start-up innovation. Today, we support digital transformation for some of the world's largest enterprises. By partnering with both large and small players, we stay at the leading edge of technology, remain nimble even as a global leader, and create technology that helps our clients further enhance their business. We are a values-driven organization and our culture of Relentless Performance has enabled over 99% of Miratech's engagements to succeed by meeting or exceeding our scope, schedule, and/or budget objectives since our inception in 1989. Miratech has coverage across 5 continents and operates in over 25 countries around the world. Miratech retains nearly 1000 full-time professionals, and our annual growth rate exceeds 25%.

Job Description

We are looking for a Principal Genesys Cloud Professional Services Consultant to join our team and drive the delivery of innovative, enterprise-grade contact center solutions.

In this role, you will lead the design and implementation of advanced multi-channel customer experience platforms, leveraging deep expertise in Genesys Cloud and modern contact center technologies.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical leadership, hands‑on delivery experience, and the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable, high‑quality solutions.

Responsibilities
  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact for customers and internal stakeholders, providing expert consultancy on Genesys Cloud solutions.
  • Lead the design and delivery of end‑to‑end technical solutions, including facilitating workshops, gathering requirements, and producing technical design documentation with stakeholder sign‑off.
  • Analyze complex business and technical challenges to define scalable and effective solution architectures.
  • Own and evolve the technical architecture of Genesys solutions, introducing new technologies and best practices where appropriate.
  • Configure and optimize Genesys Cloud environments to align with changing business and operational needs.
  • Lead the planning and execution of contact center deployments, migrations, and system upgrades.
  • Act as the main escalation and coordination point for Genesys‑related matters, collaborating with internal teams and external vendors.
  • Support production readiness activities and ensure smooth transition of contact center solutions into live environments.
Qualifications
  • 5+ years of hands‑on experience supporting and optimizing large, multi‑site, complex contact center environments.
  • Experience in designing, implementing, and supporting Genesys Cloud solutions in enterprise settings.
  • Proven expertise in building routing strategies and IVR workflows using Genesys Architect
  • Experience with CRM integration (e.g., Salesforce, MS Dynamics) with the Genesys Cloud environment
  • Strong background in infrastructure planning, solution design, deployment, and lifecycle management to ensure high availability and performance.
  • Solid understanding of business processes and their alignment with customer experience technologies.
  • Deep knowledge of SIP infrastructure, including SIP protocol, Session Border Controllers (SBC), and load balancing approaches.
Nice to Have
  • Knowledge of Genesys Cloud Workforce Management (WFM): provide expert guidance and best practices to optimize workforce management processes within the Genesys Cloud environment.
  • Genesys Cloud Training: conduct training sessions for various roles, including supervisors, administrators, users, and architects, to enhance their understanding and effective use of Genesys Cloud features
  • Experience with CX Cloud from Genesys and Salesforce
Additional Information

We offer:

  • Competitive Pay and Benefits: enjoy a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, and a relocation program.
  • Work From Anywhere Culture: make the most of the flexibility that comes with remote work.
  • Growth Mindset: reap the benefits of a range of professional development opportunities, including certification programs, mentorship and talent investment programs, internal mobility and internship opportunities.
  • Global Impact: collaborate on impactful projects for top global clients and shape the future of industries.
  • Welcoming Multicultural Environment: be a part of a dynamic, global team and thrive in an inclusive and supportive work environment with open communication and regular team‑building company social events.
  • Social Sustainability Values: join our sustainable business practices focused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality.

description:
Banco de Talentos Diretor(a) de Unidade - Salvador | BA

Quer ser um diretor escolar de excelência? Vem com a gente! ️

Assumir a direção de uma escola vai muito além de ocupar um cargo: é uma oportunidade única de impactar vidas e deixar um legado na educação. Aqui no Grupo Salta, oferecemos a chance de iniciar uma jornada que vai expandir ainda mais o seu potencial. Ao fazer parte do nosso time de diretores, você vai liderar uma das escolas do maior grupo de educação básica do Brasil, inspirando as vidas da sua comunidade escolar e deixando a sua marca no cenário educacional do nosso país.

Juntos, podemos construir um futuro em que a educação seja dinâmica, transformadora e fortalecida em uma cultura de excelência. Vamos transformar histórias: a sua, a nossa e a da educação de todo o Brasil.

O primeiro passo para a excelência começa aqui. Vem com a gente e faça parte desse legado! ✨

  • Gestão da equipe pedagógica e administrativa: Supervisionar e orientar as equipes pedagógicas e administrativas, promovendo o desenvolvimento profissional e garantindo o alinhamento com as metas institucionais;
  • Gestão do calendário escolar, projetos e eventos pedagógicos da escola: Garantir o cumprimento do calendário escolar, considerando excelência, qualidade técnica, comunicação e alinhamento à cultura da escola, de todos os projetos e eventos pedagógicos;
  • Atendimento aos responsáveis: Manter um canal de comunicação eficaz e acolhedor com os pais e responsáveis, garantindo o esclarecimento de dúvidas, resolução de problemas e a construção de uma relação de confiança com a comunidade escolar;
  • Desenvolvimento de equipe: Promover a formação contínua de professores e funcionários, garantindo alinhamento às metas da escola e atualização pedagógica constante, além de realizar avaliações periódicas do desempenho docente, com feedback e suporte para aprimoramento;
  • Captação e retenção de alunos: Atuar em estratégias de marketing educacional, elaborando planos de captação e fidelização de alunos, e promover uma experiência positiva para as famílias, consolidando a escola como referência de excelência na região;
  • Inovação e excelência: Incentivar a integração de tecnologia e práticas inovadoras no ensino, acompanhando tendências educacionais e implementando melhorias contínuas no currículo e na metodologia da escola.
  • Formação superior completa em Pedagogia, Educação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida em gestão escolar, preferencialmente em instituições de grande porte;
  • Forte capacidade de liderança, comunicação e tomada de decisão;
  • Cursar ou ter cursado pós-graduação em Gestão Escolar é um diferencial.

Acreditamos que um time diverso é o caminho para cumprir a nossa missão de transformar vidas e o Brasil. Assim, incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas que se identifiquem com grupos minorizados em todas as nossas posições.

Fique tranquilo (a) ao cadastrar seus dados na vaga. O Grupo Salta segue a LGPD – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (Lei Federal 13.709/2018), que entrou em vigor em agosto de 2020, logo, garantimos responsabilidade ao utilizar seus dados somente em nosso processo seletivo, para fins de cadastro e controle de candidatos.

CONHEÇA O GRUPO SALTA EDUCAÇÃO

Somos o maior grupo de educação básica do Brasil e temos a missão de construir um país melhor para as próximas gerações. Quer saber como fazemos isso?

Acreditamos que o ensino de qualidade pode ser um modelo sustentável para impactar crianças e jovens em todo o país. E esse desafio nos move diariamente.

Para realizar esse sonho, contamos com um time inovador e criativo, cheio de energia e, principalmente, apaixonado pelo que faz. O nosso DNA é marcado pela cultura de excelência, impacto social, desenvolvimento pessoal e espírito realizador.

Acreditamos que um time diverso é o caminho para cumprir a nossa missão de transformar vidas e, por isso, visamos a contratar talentos em igualdade de oportunidades. Também levamos a inclusão a sério, pensando em processos de reconhecimento justos e éticos, além de contarmos com grupos de afinidade racial, LGBTQIA+, de pessoas com deficiência e de gênero.

Se você quer ser impulsionado para impulsionar, o Grupo Salta é o seu lugar. Venha construir um legado de transformação conosco!

Hoje somos a segunda maior rede de farmácias do Brasil , que é fruto de uma estratégia que combina eficiência, proximidade com o cliente e fortalecimento dos nossos consultórios farmacêuticos.

Nosso modelo de negócio une produtos, serviços e cuidado contínuo. Atuamos no varejo de especialidade com o conceito de drugstore e evoluímos para um hub integrado de saúde.

Trabalhar aqui é fazer parte de um ambiente que valoriza a diversidade, incentiva a autenticidade e acredita no poder da colaboração. É um lugar para crescer, contribuir e gerar impacto todos os dias. Bora juntos?

description:
Ford abre vagas para 150 funcionários em Camaçari

14 de Julho de 2017 | 16h 57

Foto: Reprodução

Para aumentar a produção da fábrica, a montadora Ford, localizada no Polo Industrial de Camaçari, divulgou a abertura de cerca de 150 vagas para funcionários. “A Ford confirma que, durante o mês de julho, vai realizar cerca de 150 contratações para atender demanda de exportação”, disse a empresa em nota.

Para o diretor da montadora, Ricardo Menezes, com as novas contratações, a produção deverá aumentar de 900 para 1.100 carros por dia. A seleção será realizada pela empresa RH e Cia . A Ford, porém, não informou os detalhes dos cargos e da seleção. As informações são do Jornal Correio.

description:
AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US

If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Product Manager , you’ll define strategy, lead teams, and deliver digital products that engage millions of users worldwide. Combining data-driven insights with market knowledge, you’ll shape product vision, mentor peers, and collaborate across functions. This role offers high impact, growth, and the chance to influence the future of digital media .

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Product Strategy – Develop and communicate a clear product strategy and vision for IGN’s digital platforms and products, aligning it with the company’s goals and objectives
  • Product Leadership – Lead multiple product teams and drive product strategy for a larger portfolio of products.
  • Team Leadership – Lead and mentor a team of product managers, providing guidance and support to help them achieve their goals and deliver high-quality products.
  • Product Roadmap – Define and maintain the product roadmap for multiple products, ensuring it aligns with business priorities, user needs, and market trends. Make data-driven decisions and prioritize features accordingly.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration – Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, editorial, and marketing, to ensure successful product development and delivery.
  • User Research – Conduct and analyze user research to gain a deep understanding of user needs, preferences, and pain points. Use this data to inform product decisions and improvements.
  • User Experience (UX) – Work with UX/UI designers to create user-friendly and visually appealing products. Ensure a seamless and engaging user experience across IGN’s digital platforms.
  • Data Analysis – Utilize data analytics and key performance indicators (KPIs) to monitor product performance, identify areas for improvement, and make data-driven decisions to optimize the product.
  • Product Development – Oversee the end-to-end product development process, from ideation to release. Coordinate with development teams to deliver high-quality products on schedule.
  • Project Management – Define and prioritize product features, enhancements, and requirements based on customer feedback, market research, and business impact. Collaborate with product managers to ensure that product feature prioritization aligns with the overall product strategy and roadmap.
  • Product Launch – Plan and execute successful product launches, including marketing strategies and user communication. Monitor product performance post-launch and iterate based on user feedback.
  • Stakeholder Communication – Keep stakeholders informed about the status of ongoing projects, milestones, and potential roadblocks. Maintain transparency and ensure alignment with business goals.
  • Market and Competitive Analysis – Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and the competitive landscape to identify opportunities and threats in the market.
  • User Feedback and Support – Engage with user feedback, reviews, and support channels to address user concerns, gather insights, and drive product improvements.

MUST HAVES

  • 5-7 years working on technology-powered products as either a product manager or user researcher;
  • Strong understanding of digital media platforms, technologies, and industry trends ;
  • Proven ability to build intuitive content management systems that meet both internal and external customer needs;

title: Director of Ecommerce
description:
Based in San Francisco and handcrafted in Spain, Frēda Salvador is building community from the ground up. Footwear and accessories handmade in our family factories in Spain and EL Salvador.

We are a fast paced start up and are hustling everyday. We are driven. We are small, but mighty with strong values in teamwork and a positive and supportive work environment.

We are looking for a passionate, analytical, and creative Ecom & Digital leader. This role will drive the ecom business efforts across all digital channels. The ideal candidate is passionate about our customer data, understands fashion & luxury products, and knows how to drive the full funnel Ecommerce experience. This role owns all aspects of Ecommerce.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Director of Ecommerce & Retention will own and lead the Fredasalvador.com business. This leader is responsible for the full-funnel ecommerce experience, from guiding customer acquisition in partnership with performance marketing teams to owning the entire post-purchase lifecycle. You will own the ecommerce P&L, lead financial forecasting, and serve as the strategic engine for digital growth, scaling the brand through data-driven decisions and best-in-class customer experiences.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • P&L & Forecasting: Take full accountability for hitting monthly, quarterly, and annual ecommerce sales plans. Lead both top-down and bottom-up financial forecasting, identifying proactive opportunities and reactive pivots based on business trends. Partner with planning, merchandising and paid media teams.
  • Channel Leadership: Drive the ecommerce business efforts across all digital and direct mail channels.
  • Budget Oversight: Direct responsibility for managing the annual and monthly Ecommerce P&L, including management and authority for third-party technology.
  • Identify new opportunities for scale, and partner with leadership to execute.
  • Consistent awareness of competitive landscape and key action items
  • Lead data analytics reporting, and utilize insights to drive scale.
  • Identify evolving technology needs and execute new initiatives.
  • Drive scale sustainably, work towards scale within the company budget finding creative ways to maximize and optimize while testing new initiatives.
  • People/Team Management. Leading, coaching, upskilling and mentoring of direct reports.
  • Be customer obsessed, drive loyalty and retention.
  • Monitor and analyze customer lifecycle, create strategies to drive growth.
2. CRM, Lifecycle & Retention (Full Ownership)
  • Retention Strategy: Own the "Repeat Customer Rate" and "LTV" metrics. Develop and revamp comprehensive lifecycle marketing strategies to drive customer loyalty.
  • Email & SMS: Own and run end-to-end programs, from campaign planning and A/B testing to execution and performance analysis.
  • Loyalty & Referrals: Level up the Yotpo Loyalty program, making recommendations to improve engagement, reward redemption, and "Refer a Friend" initiatives.
  • CRM Analytics: Partner with agencies to build advanced customer segments for highly targeted email and on-site experiences.
  • Shopify Management: Oversee day-to-day site operations, including product launches, collection updates, and promotions.
  • User Experience: Coordinate plans for CRO and UX/UI testing to optimize engagement and conversion.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner with Planning and Merchandising to ensure the digital channel has the right assortments and inventory to support the forecast.
  • Directly responsible for managing the budget and relationship with our external development team; working closely to not only maintain the site but work towards ongoing site optimization and enhancement.
4. Marketing & Paid Media Support
  • Performance Partnership: you will serve as the strategic partner to the growth team, digital agency and marketing team to support growth across all paid channels (PPC, SEO, Social, Affiliate, and Influencer Marketing) as these channels relate to driving the forecast.
  • Conversion Optimization: Provide conversion, product, and landing page recommendations to marketing and agency partners to ensure a seamless experience for traffic coming from performance media.
REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE
  • Experience: 6+ years in digital brand strategy, e-commerce and digital marketing, with 2+ years of experience leading and managing a team.
  • Technical Proficiency: Expert knowledge of Shopify+, Google Analytics, and retention platforms like Attentive or Klaviyo.
  • Analytical Mindset: Proven ability to define and deliver performance metrics and glean actionable creative insights from data.
  • Background: Experience in the fashion or luxury space is preferred, with an entrepreneurial spirit comfortable in a fast-paced startup environment.
COMPANY BENEFITS AND COMPENSATION

This is a full time position. Alongside a unique and incredible culture, FREDA SALVADOR offers competitive salaries commensurate with experience and education and a benefits package that includes flexible vacation time, group medical, dental and vision plans, an employer-sponsored 401K retirement plan, flexible hybrid work schedule, and a generous discounts and shoe gratis program.

Título

Local
